task.summary: Deploy the approved cat-door launcher version of Radeq.cz to the live radeq.cz Cloudflare Worker.

model_or_worker.name: Codex GPT-5 desktop session
model_or_worker.role: deployment operator, verifier, and governance recorder

reasoning_profile.change_policy: Owner explicitly approved production deployment to radeq.cz. Cloudflare Worker deploy was allowed. No DNS mutation, mailbox mutation, D1 migration, production lead submission, checkout/payment, model-backed chatbot, GitHub merge, or GitHub production release was performed.

token_efficiency_profile.context_scope: Radeq product branch, Wrangler config, Cloudflare docs for deploy/keep-vars, dry-run/deploy output, public HTTP checks, live mobile Playwright check, and Autopilot records.

input_packet_summary.summary: Owner requested deployment of the already-pushed cat-door launcher branch to the live radeq.cz domain.

output_pointer.summary: Live radeq.cz serves product commit 7d62255 with the cat-door launcher and current static public pages.

verification_evidence.evidence: npm.cmd run build passed for production root build with the known Vite large chunk warning.
npx.cmd wrangler@latest deploy --dry-run --keep-vars passed and showed ASSETS, LEADS_DB, and EMAIL bindings.
npx.cmd wrangler@latest deploy --keep-vars uploaded 24 new or modified static assets and deployed Worker radeq version 20bc4a38-c5c0-41a9-a979-ff57cafbb54f.
Live HTTP checks returned 200 for /, /ukazky/, /ukazky/chatbot/, /ukazky/automatizace/, /ukazky/nabidka-eshop/, and /sitemap.xml.
OPTIONS https://radeq.cz/api/leads returned 204 with POST, OPTIONS. No production lead insert was submitted.

Live mobile Playwright check at 390 x 920 found trigger label Otevrit kocici vstup, aria-pressed=false, panel about 94 x 112 px, no H1 overlap, no horizontal overflow, and canonical https://radeq.cz/.
wrangler deployments list --name radeq showed version 20bc4a38-c5c0-41a9-a979-ff57cafbb54f at 100% traffic.

failure_labels.label: initial_api_token_auth_failure
failure_labels.resolution: Removed the insufficient CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN from the deployment process and used the local Wrangler OAuth session with account ID set for the process.

prompt_or_input_delta.summary: Owner changed the previous GitHub-only staging boundary to explicit production deployment on radeq.cz.
prompt_or_input_delta.rollback_path: Rollback Cloudflare Worker radeq from version 20bc4a38-c5c0-41a9-a979-ff57cafbb54f to the previous deployment/version, or redeploy previous product commit 1efc86b.
